reason: The bound queue contains seven complete events, 42 available primary selections across NBA and NHL, and 26 captured forecasts awaiting applicability review; all four researchers and both critical reviewers have disjoint useful work.

scalingDecisions.reason: Seven complete events divide into four disjoint event queues while two independent reviewers can challenge actionable cases and audit quote, forecast, personnel and calibration evidence.
scalingDecisions.expectedQualityBenefit: Complete market-family coverage plus independent opposing-case and evidence-identity checks before coordinator merge.
scalingDecisions.releaseCondition: Each worker returns its bound result or reports an exact failure; no individual failure creates a report-wide veto.

qualityFindings: All seven event packets were returned with moneyline, primary spread or puck-line, and total coverage; the coordinator retained only the five events still pregame at final report time.
The 52 recorded forecast captures represented two observations of 26 logical source points, not 52 independent opinions; 36 applicable bindings remained after started-event exclusion.
Phoenix-Golden State totals were blocked because the executable 227.5 contract did not match the qualified Pinnacle period-0 main total of 228.
Toronto-Clippers exact spread contracts were repaired and validated; the Miami away-spread raw sign conflict remained blocked because no exact paired reference resolved it.
The proposed Utah +16.5 and Lakers -2.5 LEAN cases were not promoted because each lacked a second qualified exact-contract source or calibrated uncertainty support.
Guy's early shortlist was empty, so no Guy event call was required; no independent Graham context was repurposed into selection evidence.
reasoningCorrections: Duplicate source captures were treated as observations of the same logical forecast point rather than independent corroboration.
Boston-Houston and Utah-San Antonio were removed from the final eligible inventory after their 18:30 PT starts; twelve completed pregame assessments remain research history only.
Personnel dependencies were narrowed to concepts actually supported by recorded official facts; no starter, availability, goalie or lineup fact was inferred beyond the source record.
Reviewer concern about the UTC offset was withdrawn after applying the authority's permanent UTC-7 schedule convention.
